name: wf-postmortem
description: wf postmortem pack: the postmortem capability, a presence-only feature that ships a guided skill hunting a described failure through prior agent sessions the maintainer names explicitly. Each named session is read by its own isolated reader agent on a cheaper model tier — in ordered windows when a record is too large for one reader — so raw session content never enters the host context, and the report's summary, evidence record, reader-counted measured effect and coverage statement are composed only from those readers' already-redacted blocks. Owns no provider surface and attaches no phase fragment — it ships inert until registered and behaves identically whether or not it is. Locating sessions, verification, fix direction, and cap enforcement arrive with later charter sub-tasks. Ships /wf-postmortem:postmortem, the guided skill, plus /wf-postmortem:init for one-command self-registration.
